verdict.rationale: Docs confirm PlanetScale Postgres ships with a managed PgBouncer instance (with its own dashboard/graphs), meaning the platform-engineer doesn't need to deploy or operate a separate pooler themselves. However, there's no explicit documentation quantifying concurrent-connection capacity ('thousands of connections') or describing pooler configuration/tuning options, and MySQL/Vitess-side pooling (vttablet) isn't mentioned at all in the pack. Missing for 10: explicit connection-capacity claims/benchmarks, pooler configuration docs, and confirmation this applies to the MySQL/Vitess product line as well as Postgres.
